answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that vests over a long horizon before it can bridge value between services: the bond is locked, and a quartz-like audit log records every claim so duplicates are visible. Creating many fake identities then means funding many separate bonds, and any identity caught double-claiming loses its stake. Honest agents recover the bond, so the cost falls mainly on attackers, while a single operator cannot cheaply multiply influence.
